description: Keys excluded from the question content signature at every depth. Both the Python snapshot ledger (server/generate/snapshot_ledger.py, via src/common/generation_events.CONTENT_SIGNATURE_EXCLUDED_KEYS) and the TypeScript evidence reducer (web/src/lib/generationEvidence.ts, CONTENT_SIDECAR_FIELDS) must exclude exactly this set. A drift test (tests/test_932_sidecar_contract.py) asserts the Python constant matches; the TS module imports this list so a rename fails both sides simultaneously.
